briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 surpasses human-level reasoning as US-China compute tensions escalate

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI with new model releases and massive infrastructure builds. Prompt injection attacks surge in production deployments while regulatory scrutiny intensifies globally.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion-2 with advanced multi-agent capabilities. Anthropic's Claude 4.5 and Google's Gemini 3 compete on long-context benchmarks while Meta open-sources Llama 4.5.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent and edge deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra clusters to xAI and Microsoft. TSMC reports record AI chip orders amid new US export controls on advanced semiconductors to China.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the gap with proprietary frontier systems before regulatory frameworks lock in market leaders?
